entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.

Hi... uhm, I need to make a return, I think. The website is just so confusing. I bought a helmet, but I'm not sure about the color. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it. I'm just so lost with all this. Can't you just help me?

Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly help you look into that return. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A fault? I don't think so. I... I just feel like I picked the wrong one. Now that I've been looking more, I'm worried about its safety features for the type of riding I do. It's all a bit overwhelming. The color just seems wrong now, too.
I completely understand. Choosing the right gear for your safety is the most important part. Let me just pull up your order details and review the policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I see the order here for the helmet. It looks like it was delivered about two months ago. Let's see... Yes, according to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, really? 90 days? I couldn't find that anywhere. So... does that mean I can send it back? You can process it for me?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's within the timeframe and you've mentioned the box is unopened, I can approve this return right away. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label now. Just print it out and attach it to the original box.
Wow, that's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, David. I was really worried I'd be stuck with it.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy and feel safe. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Have a great day, and ride safely.
